name: Group Context: Domain
description: Provides a Group context based on Domain so blocks, Group Sites, etc. can consume it
project_description: Bridges the Group and Domain modules by tying a single Group entity to a single Domain record, then exposing the active domain's Group as a Drupal core context. Once a group is assigned to a domain on the domain record form (permission 'set domain group'), the 'Group from domain' context provider returns that group on every request served from the domain, regardless of the route, and a matching 'url.site.group' cache context lets any consuming code be cached per-group. This makes group-context-aware blocks (for example the Group operations block) and integrations like the Group Sites module work across a whole tenant domain rather than only on pages that carry a group ID in the URL. A DomainGroupUnique validation constraint enforces the one-group-per-domain, one-domain-per-group relationship.
